Thanks for the context. Quick rundown of the rules and next steps from billing/ops: 

- Self-serve promos normally attach to the workspace created at signup and are not automatically transferable.
- We do allow manual reallocation in exceptional PLG cases (mismatched staging/prod) for up to 2,000 promo credits when the account is validated.

What I need before I can perform the move: 
1) Written confirmation from the customer that workspace_prod_47 is the intended production workspace (Talya has provided but please confirm receipt).
2) The signup event timestamp (we can accept an approximate time window).
3) A signed promo-terms acknowledgment for this promo (attached: promo-terms.pdf).

If we get those, I will: 
- Create ticket RDW-5249 and schedule the manual credit transfer for the next maintenance window (usually within 24 hours).
- If the transfer will miss their demo window, we can grant a 7-day trial extension immediately so the customer isn't blocked.

Marissa — please review the attached promo-terms and confirm final approval.

Thanks,
Dev
Senior Billing Engineer, Redwood Inference
